<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="21" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#1A1A1A">9:41</text>
    <line x1="322" y1="13" x2="322" y2="19" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="327" y1="11" x2="327" y2="19" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="332" y1="9" x2="332" y2="19" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="344" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="18" x2="350" y2="21" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="358" y="9" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="360" y="11" width="15" height="8" rx="2" fill="#001B94"/>
    <rect x="378" y="13" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#5E5E5E"/>
  </g>

  <!-- header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="61" r="20" fill="#001B94"/>
    <text x="31" y="69" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter Black, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="900" fill="#FFFFFF">P</text>
    <text x="65" y="56" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">GOOD MORNING, PRIYA</text>
    <text x="65" y="76" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="800" fill="#1A1A1A">Where will you fly?</text>
    <circle cx="350" cy="61" r="18" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="55" x2="356" y2="55" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="61" x2="356" y2="61" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="67" x2="356" y2="67" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- hero -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="96" width="354" height="146" rx="20" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity=".25"/>
    <rect x="18" y="94" width="354" height="146" rx="20" fill="#E2EEF5"/>
    <circle cx="315" cy="122" r="28" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".45"/>
    <circle cx="343" cy="151" r="40" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".28"/>
    <polygon points="18,206 95,160 153,190 227,145 372,211 372,240 18,240" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8"/>
    <polygon points="18,224 103,181 175,216 245,174 372,221 372,240 18,240" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity=".65"/>
    <polygon points="259,125 304,152 352,157 353,163 303,160 273,180 264,178 285,158 248,141" fill="#001B94"/>
    <polygon points="279,145 267,119 272,117 292,147" fill="#001B94"/>
    <polygon points="290,158 308,177 302,180 282,160" fill="#001B94"/>
    <text x="38" y="126" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#001B94">FLY MORE, PAY LESS</text>
    <text x="38" y="153" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="21" font-weight="800" fill="#1A1A1A">Your next journey</text>
    <text x="38" y="174" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Discover great fares across India</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="38" y="191" width="104" height="29" rx="15" fill="#001B94"/>
      <text x="90" y="210" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">EXPLORE FLIGHTS</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- booking card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="258" width="354" height="433" rx="22" fill="#5E5E5E" opacity=".10"/>
    <rect x="18" y="255" width="354" height="433" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="286" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#1A1A1A">Book your flight</text>
    <text x="38" y="305" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Find the best fares for your next trip</text>

    <!-- trip type -->
    <circle cx="44" cy="331" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="331" r="4" fill="#001B94"/>
    <text x="58" y="335" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#1A1A1A">One-way</text>
    <circle cx="143" cy="331" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C2C2C2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="157" y="335" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Round trip</text>
    <circle cx="263" cy="331" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C2C2C2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="277" y="335" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Multi-city</text>

    <!-- origin destination -->
    <text x="38" y="365" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">FROM</text>
    <rect x="38" y="372" width="314" height="52" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="56" y="394" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#1A1A1A">Delhi</text>
    <text x="56" y="412" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">DEL  ·  Indira Gandhi International</text>
    <circle cx="335" cy="398" r="12" fill="#E2EEF5"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="398" x2="340" y2="398" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="337,395 340,398 337,401" fill="none" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="38" y="449" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">TO</text>
    <rect x="38" y="456" width="314" height="52" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="56" y="478" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#C2C2C2">Select destination</text>
    <text x="56" y="496" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#A5A5A5">Airport or city</text>
    <circle cx="335" cy="482" r="12" fill="#E2EEF5"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="482" x2="340" y2="482" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="337,479 340,482 337,485" fill="none" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- date and passengers -->
    <text x="38" y="534" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">DEPARTURE</text>
    <rect x="38" y="541" width="151" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="55" y="564" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="800" fill="#1A1A1A">18 Jun 2025</text>
    <text x="55" y="582" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Wednesday</text>
    <rect x="163" y="556" width="13" height="14" fill="none" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="163" y1="561" x2="176" y2="561" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="204" y="534" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">PASSENGERS</text>
    <rect x="204" y="541" width="148" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="225" cy="558" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="225" cy="573" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="242" y="565" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="800" fill="#1A1A1A">1 Adult</text>
    <text x="242" y="583" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Economy</text>
    <polyline points="329,562 334,567 339,562" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <g>
      <rect x="38" y="618" width="314" height="48" rx="20" fill="#001B94"/>
      <text x="183" y="648" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">SEARCH FLIGHTS</text>
      <circle cx="294" cy="642" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="299" y1="647" x2="304" y2="652" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="679" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Prices shown include all taxes and fees</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="721" width="390" height="123" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="60" y1="721" x2="330" y2="721" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- home -->
    <polygon points="38,759 51,748 64,759" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="43" y="758" width="16" height="14" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="793" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Home</text>
    <!-- book active -->
    <rect x="123" y="749" width="22" height="25" rx="3" fill="#001B94"/>
    <line x1="128" y1="756" x2="140" y2="756" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="128" y1="762" x2="140" y2="762" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="128" y1="768" x2="136" y2="768" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="134" y="793" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#001B94">Book</text>
    <!-- flight status -->
    <circle cx="232" cy="761" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="232" y1="753" x2="232" y2="761" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="232" y1="761" x2="238" y2="765" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="232" y="793" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Flight Status</text>
    <!-- check in -->
    <rect x="310" y="750" width="25" height="22" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="315,760 320,765 330,755" fill="none" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="322" y="793" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Check-in</text>
  </g>
</svg>
